title: Surreal Kitchen Reflection
description: A woman with three faces and cracking skin stands in a decaying kitchen, holding a white mask to one of her faces while looking toward the viewer. The scene is filled with surreal elements including a yellow refrigerator covered in eyeballs, a black sink overflowing with purple flowers and green liquid, floating theatrical masks, a large stained glass window depicting a ringed planet and red orbs, and a lavender field beyond.
prompt: A surreal scene in a decaying kitchen where a woman in a green dress with three visible faces and cracking porcelain-like skin holds a white mask to one face. A yellow refrigerator is covered in eyeballs and red orbs, a black sink overflows with purple flowers and dripping green liquid. Theatrical masks float on the walls, a large arched stained glass window shows a ringed red planet and floating orbs above a lavender field. Foreground has a crystal ball, pomegranate, and scattered art supplies on the counter, in a detailed surreal painting style.
